packageRules.description: Keep engines.node / engines.pnpm as loose ranges — never pin them, so installing weaver doesn't force consumers onto an exact runtime version. 'replace' only acts when the range stops covering the latest, so a >= range is left untouched.
TS 7 removed the classic Compiler API that Volar's LanguageServiceHost and weaver's own diagnostics code depend on. Revisit when Volar ships TS7 support.

Vitest 5 matches testNamePattern against the suite chain joined with ' > ', while @stryker-mutator/vitest-runner 10.0.0 builds its filter from space-joined names. No mutant then selects a test to run, so every covered mutant is reported Survived. Unpin when stryker-mutator/stryker-js#6214 ships (issue #6210).
